concerns.text: FR-005 (Mantel test with 999 permutations) and SC-001 are unmet. Task T019 is marked incomplete (checkbox unchecked). The spec mandates exactly 999 permutations, but the task description notes a default of 9,999 in the analyze report context, and the task itself is not marked as done, leaving the core statistical validation of US-1 without a completed implementation task.

FR-006 (Partial Mantel test) and SC-002 are unmet. Task T023 (Integration test for Partial Mantel) is marked incomplete. Without this test and the associated implementation logic in T026/T027 being fully verified as complete, the requirement to isolate environmental signal via Partial Mantel is not covered by a completed task.

FR-007 (Visualization and Reporting) and SC-002 are unmet. Task T032 (Text summary generator) is marked incomplete. The spec requires a text summary containing headline r, p-value, and comparative ratio. T032 is the only task covering this deliverable, and its incomplete status means the reporting requirement is not covered.

FR-001 (Data loss thresholds) and US-1 Acceptance 3 are unmet. Task T020a (Orchestration logic for data loss) is marked incomplete. The spec requires the system to halt if >20% data loss occurs. T020a is the specific task implementing this guardrail; its incomplete status leaves the requirement uncovered.

SC-003 (80% data retention) verification is unmet. Task T020b depends on T020a. Since T020a is incomplete, T020b cannot functionally verify the retention percentage against the threshold, leaving SC-003 without a valid verification path in the task list.

Constitution Principle VII (Environmental Stratification) verification is unmet. Task T025b (Stratified subset analysis) is marked complete, but the Analyze Report indicates T025b is not explicitly linked to a verification step ensuring the `stratified_analysis.txt` report is generated with specific r-value comparisons. While T025b exists, the lack of a dedicated verification task or explicit linkage in the incomplete T027 creates a gap in covering the 'comparison' requirement of Principle VII.
